finding.title: Kata final acceptance must require the upstream currently supported release window, not only a historical patched minimum
current_contract_strength: fresh upstream security-advisory review required immediately before final acceptance
exact runtime/configuration and guest-kernel identity required
finding.residual_gap: The observed contract does not explicitly require the exact installed Kata/runtime-rs release to remain inside upstream's then-current supported release window. Upstream's current security policy is rolling-release/current-release only, so a historically patched but unsupported release should not be accepted merely because no individually enumerated advisory is known.
proposed_nonduplicate_delta: Require the exact installed Kata/runtime-rs release to be within upstream's currently supported release window at final acceptance.
Bind the upstream support-policy identity used by the acceptance receipt.
Keep 3.31.0 only as a historical lower-bound fence for CVE-2026-47243, never as sufficient current acceptance.
Add a static regression that preserves this support-window requirement while leaving actual runtime proof to the target MicroVM acceptance run.
finding.falsifier: Reject this delta if upstream changes to a support policy that admits a separately maintained older release line and the exact target release is demonstrably inside that supported line; the contract should bind the then-current upstream policy rather than hard-code rolling release forever.

primary_upstream_evidence.observation: runtime-rs <= 3.30.0 affected; 3.31.0 patched; critical guest-root to host-root escape via virtiofs
Kata security policy states rolling monthly releases and only the current release series receives security fixes; prior releases are unsupported
3.31.0 release lists CVE-2026-47243 as a key security fix

coordination.reason: Canonical MicroVM contract changed concurrently while this organ was preparing the support-window delta; no newer main bytes were overwritten.
coordination.parallel_new_main_observation: Tier-2 contract was independently strengthened so a container restart in the same Kata Pod/sandbox cannot be misclassified as full-appliance recovery.

unusual_experiment.reason: No shared immutable request/turn id is exposed for this go trigger; minute-precision trigger identity is insufficient under current atomic experiment law.

next_exact_gate: After approved host-side Vercel Preview GITHUB_READ_TOKEN provisioning, refresh/rebind exact current Research main plus retained #611/#622 and complete EntityOS source identities; execute the retained exact OCI batch, then deploy that same digest under a currently supported advisory-clean Kata/equivalent runtime and prove guest-kernel, NetworkPolicy/CNI, Tier-2 full-sandbox replacement, recovery, no-replay and dual-user generation fences.
